title: Recover and rename Agentic SDLC
description: Finish Seeds distribution, remove CAO, perform one atomic state-v3/canonical identity cutover, and harden release lifecycle. Outward rename and publication operations remain separately authorized.

title: Expand Agentic SDLC capabilities
description: Build shared role contracts, change writing, Git-first activation, hierarchical instructions, bounded Deep Work Loop, HyperResearch, Git flow, and toolchain security as independent reviewed lanes.

title: Certify and enable jj opt-in
description: Certify jj compatibility in isolated fixtures, implement opt-in colocated workspaces with immutable Git handoff, then add a non-default init profile.

title: Build the complete Mermaid skill family
description: Certify a portable browser/render foundation, build one installable skill for each of 30 Mermaid 11.16.0 diagram types, add one router, and prove conformance.

title: Build Evolutionary Core and portability
description: Deliver deterministic one-item Core Milestone 2, Claude Golden Wave Milestone 3, portability and pack lifecycle Milestone 4, then certify optional CCP/ccodex lifecycle.

title: Certify workflow model routing
description: Record exact Sol/Terra/Luna model, effort, and [1m] probes. Preserve the verified outputs and explicitly record that transcripts expose resolved base model but not resolved effort or a distinct [1m] context signal; use bounded fallback decomposition.

title: Archive plans and roadmap evidence
description: Archive the prior and approved plans, decision register, recovered request/audit summary, roadmap/dependency map, and workflow certification receipt under docs without transient tool dumps or secrets.

title: Finish exact Seeds 0.5.14 execution contract
description: Replace the final bare sd calls, make Research Director emit SeedProposal rather than mutate the queue, expand recursive shipped-surface validation, and run Linux plus native Windows gates.

title: Review and integrate Seeds 0.5.14 wave
description: One integrator applies exact non-overlapping toolchain and execution ranges to an integration branch, recomputes footprint and commit counts, independently reviews the immutable result, and re-runs full gates. No push or PR.

title: Remove CAO completely
description: Delete every shipped CAO path, flag, profile, tombstone, command, reference, and runtime behavior. Retain only a private validator denylist and negative fixtures that prevent regression.

title: Cut over to canonical agentic-sdlc identity atomically
description: In one cumulative deployable head, add state v3 migration, rename the flagship skill and all public identity surfaces, preserve old ownership witnesses by mode, add crash recovery, and test the supported Claude marketplace CLI plane. Do not rename the checkout or GitHub repository.

title: Harden release lifecycle before Core
description: Add version/support policy, compatibility matrix, reproducible source archive and SHA-256 verification, attestation policy, offline bundle, lifecycle migration/rollback/recovery fixtures, cross-platform receipts, and governance documents.

title: Rename local checkout directory
description: After separate approval, inventory worktrees and ownership receipts, rename the main checkout, repair linked worktrees, transactionally retarget exact owned installs, re-gate, and retain move-back recovery.

title: Rename GitHub repository to Codeseys-Labs/agentic-sdlc
description: After separate approval, inventory repository identity and integrations, rename by repository ID, verify redirects/permissions/CI, then update remotes and public URLs in a separate change.

title: Consolidate shared role and artifact contracts
description: Create provider-neutral versioned role contracts and typed Map, ResearchBrief, SeedProposal, Candidate, ReviewFinding, and IntegrationReport artifacts while preserving separation of powers and unique integrator authority.

title: Build attribution-free change-writing skill
description: Implement output-only commit, PR, squash, and draft-review modes with evidence-based claims and attribution opt-in only, plus falsifiable forbidden-output fixtures.

title: Harden Git-default sdlc-init
description: Add Git profile, optional TTY selection, deterministic headless default, cancellation/no-write, dry-run ActivationPlan, receipts, rollback/deactivation, marker-safe guidance, and rerun idempotence.

title: Generate hierarchical repository instructions
description: Implement one dry-run-first marker-aware generator for root and subtree AGENTS.md, thin CLAUDE.md, and .claude/rules files while preserving hand-authored content.

title: Build bounded Deep Work Loop
description: Consolidate the mission/tier doctrine into frame, map/research, decide, act, verify, critique, and reconcile without creating a second queue, integration authority, publication plane, or unbounded recursion.

title: Harden HyperResearch and Research OS
description: Require load-bearing external evidence artifacts and harden the Research OS installer with owned inventory/digests, dry-run parity, recovery, rollback, and permanent foreign-file refusal.

title: Consolidate Git change-flow knowledge
description: Consolidate branch, worktree, rebase, squash, merge, stacked-PR, exact lease, footprint, recovery, and re-gating guidance without duplicating routers.

title: Harden repository toolchain and security gates
description: Extend the existing mise gate graph with lefthook subset rules, betterleaks working-tree and approved history scans, worktree trust guidance, CI parity, and exact receipt evidence.

title: Certify jj 0.43.0 compatibility and handoff
description: Use official documentation and isolated fixture repositories to prove supported colocation, native jj workspaces, conflicts/recovery, unsupported-feature refusal, and immutable conflict-free Git OID handoff.

title: Implement explicit jj-colocated opt-in
description: Pin the certified jj version and implement explicit opt-in native jj workspaces, mandatory gates, conflict rejection, recovery receipts, Git/gh forge authority, and user-data-preserving disablement.

title: Add jj-colocated profile to sdlc-init
description: Amend the hardened init workflow only after jj certification and implementation pass. Require explicit selection and compatibility probes; never make jj the headless default.

title: Certify Mermaid dependency and browser foundation
description: Prove a locked Mermaid 11.16.0 and CLI dependency graph, pinned cross-platform browser provider, deterministic DOM/render wrapper, trusted config, fresh-host install, offline render, and bounded resources.

title: Build Mermaid validator and SVG safety foundation
description: Implement current detect/parse/render/run and CLI validation, strict initialization, deterministic isolation, bounded inputs, and parsed SVG element/attribute/protocol allowlists with malicious fixture rejection.

title: Build structural Mermaid diagram skills
description: Create real installable skills and valid/invalid/accessibility/render fixtures for Flowchart, Swimlanes, Sequence, Class, State, and Entity Relationship.

title: Build planning Mermaid diagram skills
description: Create real installable skills and valid/invalid/accessibility/render fixtures for User Journey, Gantt, Timeline, Kanban, Requirement, and Mindmap.

title: Build quantitative Mermaid diagram skills
description: Create real installable skills and valid/invalid/accessibility/render fixtures for Pie, Quadrant, Sankey, XY Chart, Radar, and Treemap.

title: Build technical Mermaid diagram skills
description: Create real installable skills and valid/invalid/accessibility/render fixtures for GitGraph, C4, Block, Packet, Architecture, and Event Modeling.

title: Build conceptual Mermaid diagram skills
description: Create real installable skills and valid/invalid/accessibility/render fixtures for ZenUML, Venn, Ishikawa, Wardley, Cynefin, and TreeView.

title: Build Mermaid umbrella router
description: Select exactly one official installed diagram type, link all 30 skills, reject ambiguity and unsupported requests, and never invent syntax.

title: Certify Mermaid bundle conformance
description: Prove one router plus exactly 30 skills, official inventory parity, valid detect/parse/render, invalid rejection, CLI smoke, accessibility requirements, malicious SVG safety, and mise gate integration.

title: Build Evolutionary Core Milestone 2
description: Build deterministic one-item contracts, journal, fake adapter, immutable candidates, independent review, gate and canonical receipt, then Git identity/fencing/reconciliation, integration rollback, crash suite, and Seeds projection.

title: Build Claude Golden Wave Milestone 3
description: Certify direct-Claude capability readback, bounded isolated assignments, exact routing, disk artifacts, repair/recovery, idempotent publication, and multi-language fixtures.

title: Build portability and pack lifecycle Milestone 4
description: Add Codex conformance, a third minimal adapter, and versioned owned first-party pack install/update/rollback/uninstall before public ABI or Core promotion.

title: Certify CCP and ccodex behavior
description: Verify exact proxy/package/checksum, loopback binding, traffic privacy, external auth, exact model allowlist, [1m] behavior, and capability readback before any installation lane.

title: Implement optional CCP and ccodex lifecycle
description: After certification and user config approval, implement WSL/Windows aliases, start/status/stop/update/rollback/uninstall, orphan recovery, credential non-copying, and no Core dependency.

title: Profile all six workflow model tiers and effort levels
description: Evaluate GPT Sol/Terra/Luna and Claude Fable/Opus/Sonnet across low, medium, high, xhigh, and max effort on standardized mechanical, contained-judgment, and authority tasks. Capture quality, failures, resolved identity, effort/context observability, latency/token evidence, and roadmap routing. Do not infer production suitability from toy-task success.

title: Update bundled and global model-rightsizing skills
description: After the six-tier profile, use skill-authoring RED/GREEN/REFACTOR tests to maintain one canonical comprehensive calibration and validated projections in both the Agentic SDLC bundle and global environment. Cover provider-specific IDs/aliases, effort matrices, blast radius, quota/concurrency caveats, [1m] semantics, readback limitations, fallbacks, and roadmap examples without divergent policy.
